claim: Nvj3 PXA forms a hydrophobic lipid-compatible conduit
finding: High-confidence Nvj3-Mdm1 heterodimer in which PXA and PXC domains generate an extended tunnel spanning both proteins; core hydrophobic conduit traverses the interface; conservation enriched at the interface
confidence: Moderate. Prediction only, no ligand, no assay. Places the conduit across a heterodimer, not within the Nvj3 PXA domain alone

citation: PMID:35223850 (Paul et al. 2022, Front Cell Dev Biol)
evidence_type: structural/computational + crystal structure of SNX25 RGS
claim: PXA domains carry a lipid-binding hydrophobic cavity
finding: PXA and PXC fold into a single module featuring a large conserved hydrophobic cavity; SNX-RGS proteins proposed as a new class of lipid transfer proteins
context: Human/yeast SNX-RGS proteins, AlphaFold2 + one experimental RGS-domain structure
confidence: Moderate. The experimental structure is of the RGS domain, not PXA. The cavity claim is predicted. Explicitly a two-domain (PXA+PXC) claim

citation: PMID:26283797 (Henne et al. 2015, J Cell Biol)
claim: Nvj3 is a PI3P-binding NVJ protein
finding: Nvj3 (Ydr179w-a) named; localizes to ER-vacuole MCSs independently of Nvj1; Mdm1 binds the vacuole in trans via its PX domain; Mdm1 truncations perturb sphingolipid metabolism
context: S. cerevisiae, fluorescence microscopy and lipidomics
confidence: High for localization. The PI3P-binding activity is demonstrated for Mdm1's PX domain, which Nvj3 does not have

finding: NVJs expand under metabolic stress and are sites of LD production; ablating the NVJ causes defects in fatty acid-to-triglyceride production; Mdm1 interacts with fatty acyl-CoA synthetases
confidence: Moderate. Supports GO:0006629 at acts_upstream_of_or_within level; does not identify a molecular activity for Nvj3

claim: Nvj3 organizes lipid availability at ER contact sites
finding: Nvj3 induced by glucose depletion, recruited to LD-associated ER domains; nvj3-delta delays Dga1-dependent TAG packaging into LDs and mislocalizes DAG; altered phospholipid remodeling
confidence: Moderate. Preprint, not peer reviewed. Loss-of-function phenotype, not a direct binding assay

finding: SNX13 and SNX14 defined as lipid binding proteins localizing to ER-lysosome junctions; loss impairs lysosomal PtdIns4P signalling
confidence: Moderate-high for the human paralogs; does not localize the lipid binding to the PXA domain specifically, and does not test Nvj3

claim: Nvj3 PXA has a hydrophobic cavity comparable to other PXA domains
finding: 1242 A^3, long axis 37 A, lining KD +1.13; within family range on all metrics; PXA domains beat 12 controls at p=0.0011 (volume/residue) and p=0.0016 (lining hydrophobicity)
context: AlphaFold v4 monomer models, pLDDT 82-90 over PXA spans
confidence: Moderate. Models only; a static grid cavity is not proof of ligand binding; carving a domain can open surfaces, which the truncation controls partly address

citation: This work (orthologue conservation, 185 fungal PXA-only proteins)
claim: The cavity is under selection as a hydrophobic surface
finding: Hydrophobic-residue frequency at lining positions 0.845 vs 0.417 at burial-matched non-lining positions (p=0.0035); identity not enriched (p=0.61); entropy lower (p=4.2e-05)
confidence: Moderate. Pairwise rather than profile alignment at ~25% median identity; no specific ligand implied

citation: This work (PXA vs PXA+PXC cavity, Foldseek)
claim: The PXA domain alone is the lipid-binding unit
finding: PXC adds 3-8x cavity volume in Mdm1/SNX13/14/19/25; Nvj3 lacks PF08628 but its C-terminal half packs with the PXA module (970 contacts) and closes a 5301 A^3, 58.7 A conduit; Foldseek places Nvj3 254-463 at the PXC position of 57 long SNX-RGS proteins (median relative position 0.86, p=0.0035), E-values 0.08-2.2
confidence: Moderate for the PXA+PXC requirement, Low-moderate for the Nvj3 PXC-like assignment given weak E-values

finding: GO:0032266 is ISS (ECO:0000250) WITH SGD:S000004572 = MDM1, from PMID:26283797. Nvj3 carries only PF02194; the PX domain (PF00787) that binds PI3P in Mdm1 is absent, and Foldseek finds no PX-like region in Nvj3
confidence: High that this is a whole-protein ISS from a paralog with different domain content

claim: Structural claims about PXA rest on experiment
finding: Zero PDB hits for either half of Nvj3; no experimental structure of a PXA or PXC domain exists
confidence: High as a negative result at default Foldseek sensitivity
